title: Gus and the Snow That Went Sideways
synopsis: Gus wonders why the snow moves to the side of the plow rather than marching ahead, and Jack makes a small table-top demonstration after a second pass near Station Lane.
continuity_state: Before: An overnight snow has covered Brook Road. The town orange snowplow made an initial pass; drifts remain by curbs and roads, while Station Lane and other public roads still need clearance. After: Adult plow crews have made additional passes on Brook Road and cleared the entrance to Station Lane so the firehouse driveway is usable. Gus and Jack used a tray of loose white paper scraps indoors to see why an angled card can send them to one side. No new road or permanent structure appeared.

related_resources.reason: Supports specific physical facts, not the fictional outcome.
